title: OIE Excursion
statementMd:
Hector is on an excursion with the Spanish Olympiad in Informatics, visiting A Coruña, but he is desperate to sneak away to meet his friends Gustavo, Esomer, and Dani. To do so, he must cross a path guarded by $n$ volunteers standing in a row, numbered from $1$ to $n$; the $i$-th volunteer watches over position $i$.

Each volunteer has an internal timer. Initially (at second $0$), the $i$-th volunteer's timer has a value $a_i$. Every second, all timers increase by $1$. Once a timer reaches $m$, it wraps around to $0$. Specifically, at second $x$, the $i$-th volunteer's timer shows the value $(a_i + x) \pmod m$.

The $i$-th volunteer is only watching over position $i$ when their timer is exactly $0$. At any other time, they are distracted and will not notice Hector.

Hector starts at position $0$, to the left of all volunteers. To escape, he must reach position $n+1$. In the **end** of each second, Hector can choose to stay in his current position, move one position to the left, or move one position to the right. Note that Hector can't go to the left of position $0$.

Hector is caught if and only if, at the **beginning** of a second, he is at position $i$ ($1 \le i \le n$) and the $i$-th volunteer's timer is $0$.

Determine whether there exists a strategy for Hector to pass all volunteers and escape without being caught.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

Each test case consists of two lines:

- The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$ ($2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$, $2 \le m \le 10^9$) — the number of volunteers and the cycle length of the timers.
- The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($0 \le a_i \lt m$), where $a_i$ represents the initial value of the $i$-th volunteer's timer at $t=0$.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, print a line containing either "`YES`" or "`NO`", representing whether Hector can escape. You can output the answer in any case (upper or lower). For example, the strings "`yEs`", "`yes`", "`Yes`", and "`YES`" will be recognized as positive responses.

## Note

- Case 1: Hector can move right every second without waiting or moving left and escape, because there is no $i$ such that $(a_i + i) \pmod m = 0$.
- Case 2: One possible strategy is to wait for one second at the starting position and then move right every second without further waiting or moving left.
statementZhMd:
Hector 正随西班牙信息学奥林匹克（OIE）外出游览，参观 A Coruña，但他急切地想偷偷溜走，去见他的朋友 Gustavo、Esomer 和 Dani。为此，他必须穿过一条由 $n$ 名志愿者守卫的小路，这些志愿者站成一排，编号从 $1$ 到 $n$；第 $i$ 名志愿者看守位置 $i$。

每名志愿者都有一个内部计时器。初始时（第 $0$ 秒），第 $i$ 名志愿者的计时器的值为 $a_i$。每过一秒，所有计时器的值都增加 $1$。一旦计时器达到 $m$，它就会回绕到 $0$。具体地，在第 $x$ 秒，第 $i$ 名志愿者的计时器显示的值为 $(a_i + x) \pmod m$。

只有当计时器恰好为 $0$ 时，第 $i$ 名志愿者才在看守位置 $i$。在其他任何时刻，他们都会分心，不会注意到 Hector。

Hector 从位置 $0$ 出发，位于所有志愿者的左侧。为了逃脱，他必须到达位置 $n+1$。在每秒的**末尾**，Hector 可以选择停留在当前位置、向左移动一个位置，或向右移动一个位置。注意，Hector 不能走到位置 $0$ 的左侧。

当且仅当在某一秒的**开头**，Hector 位于位置 $i$（$1 \le i \le n$）且第 $i$ 名志愿者的计时器为 $0$ 时，他才会被抓到。

请判断是否存在一种策略，使得 Hector 能够从所有志愿者身边经过并成功逃脱而不被抓到。

## 输入格式

每个测试文件包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的组数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各组测试用例的描述。

每组测试用例由两行组成：

- 第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $m$（$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$，$2 \le m \le 10^9$）——分别表示志愿者的数量和计时器的循环周期。
- 第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$（$0 \le a_i \lt m$），其中 $a_i$ 表示第 $i$ 名志愿者的计时器在 $t=0$ 时的初始值。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试用例，输出一行，包含 "`YES`" 或 "`NO`"，表示 Hector 能否逃脱。你可以以任意大小写输出答案。例如，字符串 "`yEs`"、"`yes`"、"`Yes`" 和 "`YES`" 都会被视为肯定的回答。

## 说明

- 样例 1：Hector 可以每秒都向右移动，无需等待或向左移动即可逃脱，因为不存在满足 $(a_i + i) \pmod m = 0$ 的 $i$。
- 样例 2：一种可行的策略是先在起始位置等待一秒，然后每秒都向右移动，不再等待或向左移动。
